datasets.title: Landsat 4–9 Collection 2 Level-2 surface reflectance (SR)
datasets.access: Public metadata; Azure assets commonly need temporary SAS signing
datasets.description: Surface reflectance and available surface temperature. Covers TM, ETM+, OLI/TIRS; QA, scaling and sensor harmonization matter. Assets are HTTPS Azure blobs, so enable Planetary Computer signing when downloading.

datasets.title: Sentinel-2 Level-2A surface reflectance (SR)
datasets.access: Public metadata; many public COG assets
datasets.description: Multispectral surface reflectance. 2015 is the mission era, not guaranteed L2A catalog coverage at every location. Band resolutions and processing baselines differ.

datasets.title: Sentinel-1 ground range detected
datasets.access: Public metadata; Azure assets commonly need temporary SAS signing
datasets.description: C-band SAR acquisitions. Pixel spacing is not effective spatial resolution. GRD is not interchangeable with calibrated, terrain-corrected backscatter. Assets are HTTPS Azure blobs, so enable Planetary Computer signing when downloading.

datasets.title: Sentinel-1 radiometrically terrain-corrected
datasets.access: Public metadata; Azure assets commonly need temporary SAS signing
datasets.description: Terrain-corrected SAR for backscatter analysis. Actual archive start, polarization and regional coverage depend on the provider.

datasets.title: Copernicus DEM GLO-30
datasets.access: Public metadata; Azure assets commonly need temporary SAS signing; provider terms apply
datasets.description: Static digital surface model based mainly on TanDEM-X acquisitions from 2011–2015. Not a continuously updated terrain time series. Assets are HTTPS Azure blobs, so enable Planetary Computer signing when downloading.

datasets.title: NASADEM (reprocessed SRTM)
datasets.access: Public metadata; Azure assets commonly need temporary SAS signing
datasets.description: Static elevation from the February 2000 SRTM mission, reprocessed later. Not global polar coverage and not a current elevation observation.

datasets.title: ESA WorldCover
datasets.access: Public metadata; Azure assets commonly need temporary SAS signing
datasets.description: 2020 and 2021 global land-cover maps; not an annual current feed. Algorithm/version changes complicate direct change detection.

datasets.title: JRC Global Surface Water
datasets.provider: Microsoft Planetary Computer / European Commission JRC
datasets.access: Public metadata; Azure assets commonly need temporary SAS signing
datasets.description: Landsat-derived surface-water statistics. The provider's release determines covered years; aggregate products are not individual dated scenes.

datasets.title: MODIS Terra MOD09A1 Version 6.1
datasets.access: Public metadata; Azure assets commonly need temporary SAS signing
datasets.description: Moderate-resolution surface reflectance composites. QA and composite intervals differ from Landsat/Sentinel scenes; check current ingestion lag.

datasets.title: MODIS Terra MOD13A1 Version 6.1
datasets.access: Public metadata; Azure assets commonly need temporary SAS signing
datasets.description: Precomputed NDVI/EVI composite products. Apply product scale factors and QA before comparing values; current ingestion is provider-dependent.

datasets.title: Sentinel-2 Level-1C TOA reflectance
datasets.access: Public metadata; JP2 imagery on requester-pays S3 may require AWS/provider retrieval
datasets.description: Top-of-atmosphere reflectance product, not surface reflectance. Bands use encoded integers; read per-asset scale/offset and processing baseline. Current S3 band links are not supported by the HTTP-only downloader.

datasets.title: Landsat Collection 2 Level-1 DN (TOA calibration required)
datasets.access: Public metadata; USGS EROS login or requester-pays AWS access may be required for bands and MTL
datasets.description: Global Level-1 archive delivered as digital numbers, not calibrated TOA reflectance. Use the matching MTL coefficients and solar elevation for supported reflective bands. MSS/thermal require other calibration workflows.

datasets.title: Landsat Collection 2 US ARD TOA reflectance
datasets.resolution: 30 m reflective bands; regional ARD grid
datasets.access: Public metadata; USGS EROS login or requester-pays AWS access may be required
datasets.description: TOA reflectance ARD product with regional U.S. coverage (CONUS, Alaska, Hawaii), not a global archive. Read product scale/offset and QA; the ARD grid differs from ordinary scenes. Do not treat it as SR or apply Level-1 DN calibration again.

datasets.title: SMAP L4 surface and root-zone soil moisture
datasets.access: Public CMR metadata; native product downloads commonly require EARTHDATA_TOKEN. Files may be HDF5/NetCDF, not GeoTIFF.
datasets.description: Queries real granules and returns only provider-advertised data links. Inspect units, QA and product version before analysis.

datasets.title: EnMAP L2A hyperspectral
datasets.access: DLR account may be required for downloads
datasets.description: Actual DLR STAC items; wavelength/bad-band metadata must be inspected.

datasets.title: CHIRPS v2 daily precipitation
datasets.access: Public HTTPS; global files may be gzip-compressed
datasets.description: Lists files actually present in the provider directory. Spatial coverage 50S–50N; bbox does not crop the global download.

datasets.title: Sentinel-3 OLCI / SLSTR native products
datasets.access: Public product metadata; CDSE_ACCESS_TOKEN required to download native archives
datasets.description: Native mission products from the official OData catalog. Product level, instrument and variables vary; downloading does not derive measurements.

datasets.title: Sentinel-5P TROPOMI native products
datasets.access: Public product metadata; CDSE_ACCESS_TOKEN required to download native archives
datasets.description: Native mission products from the official OData catalog. Product level, instrument and variables vary; downloading does not derive measurements.

datasets.title: Sentinel-2 native L1C / L2A archives
datasets.access: Public product metadata; CDSE_ACCESS_TOKEN required to download native archives
datasets.description: Native mission products from the official OData catalog. Product level, instrument and variables vary; downloading does not derive measurements.

datasets.title: USGS 3DEP seamless DEM
datasets.access: Public metadata; Azure assets may need signing
datasets.description: Static elevation inventory; acquisition dates vary by tile.

datasets.title: Google Dynamic World 10 m
datasets.provider: Dynamic World Project: Google / National Geographic Society / World Resources Institute
datasets.access: Earth Engine credentials, authorized EE_PROJECT and optional earthengine extra required; small synchronous exports only
datasets.description: Returns actual scene-specific AOI-cropped label/probability GeoTIFF links. Large areas require provider batch exports.

datasets.title: EO-1 Hyperion archive metadata
datasets.access: Archive may expose collection metadata without searchable granules; USGS retrieval may be required
datasets.description: Queries actual CMR granules if present. Empty results do not prove the USGS archive is empty.

datasets.title: FIRMS VIIRS Suomi-NPP NRT hotspots
datasets.access: FIRMS_MAP_KEY required; API windows limited to 10 days
datasets.description: Actual hotspot observations as GeoJSON points; not a raster. The search manifest is the downloaded data; no asset download is needed.

datasets.title: FIRMS MODIS NRT hotspots
datasets.access: FIRMS_MAP_KEY required; API windows limited to 10 days
datasets.description: Actual hotspot observations as GeoJSON points; not a raster. The search manifest is the downloaded data; no asset download is needed.
